messages:
maria_sales: FYI MedTechEU has escalated: they want our completed SIG/CAIQ sections + a clear DSAR flow and deletion evidence for the POC telemetry. Deadline: EOD Wed EU time. Can we assemble a single-page export they can attach to their assessment?

eli_security: Understood. I can assemble CAIQ responses for the data protection sections. Need clarity on two things: 1) Are prompts captured verbatim anywhere in the hosted POC? 2) Do we persist intermediate KV caches that could contain user PII?

nora_privacy: Short answers: prompts are logged only if customer enables debug/prompt logging; default is off for hosted trials. KV caches are ephemeral in-memory; we snapshot only for debugging if requested and then purge. For the DSAR runbook I recommend a short bulleted flow + proof artifacts (export manifest + deletion audit log).

sam_infra: storage notes: embeddings go to encrypted-store (encrypted at rest with KMS). For the EU POC we can pin region to eu-west-1. Default retention values (but configurable per-POC): logs=21 days, metrics=90 days, embeddings=60 days. We can shorten to 30d for this customer.

maria_sales: They specifically want: "Where is each telemetry stored? Who has access? How long do you keep it? How do you delete it and provide proof?" If we can hand them a CSV-like row per telemetry type that would be ideal.

eli_security: I'll create a concise mapping. Also, include a control column referencing the CAIQ control ID where applicable.

legal-bot: Reminder: attach the POC DPA addendum (poc_trial_dpa_v2). Also include subprocessors list.

nora_privacy: Proposed DSAR SLA for trial: acknowledge within 48h, deliver export within 20 days, deletion completed and attested within 5 business days after confirmation. Note: legal might want longer for unusual data types.

eli_security: Mapping (CSV style) below — drop-in for their spreadsheet. I shortened labels to fit one cell each row:

```
telemetry_type,pii_risk,purpose,region,storage,encryption,access,retention_days,deletion_proof,caiq_ref
request_logs,medium,request-routing,eu-west-1,S3 project-bucket,KMS,rbac+audit,21,audit-entry + purge-job,SC-8
metrics,low,service-health,eu-west-1,TSDB (managed),disk-enc,svc-roles,90,retention-policy-log,CM-2
embeddings,high,inference-context,eu-west-1,encrypted-store,KMS,restricted-acl,60,secure-wipe + kdas,DP-3
prompts(debug only),high,debugging,eu-west-1,ephemeral-store,KMS,limited,30,manual-purge + audit-note,AP-4
kv-cache,medium,model-state,eu-west-1,mem-snapshots,NA,devops-only,0 (ephemeral),snapshot-deleted,aud-1
```

eli_security: Notes: "deletion_proof" entries point to artifacts we can generate: purge job run logs, S3 object delete markers, KMS key rotate records (where applicable), and ticketed attestation.

maria_sales: This is gold. Can you also add a one-sentence DPA-friendly clause we can paste into the trial addendum about not using customer data for training?

nora_privacy: Paste this: "Redwood will not use customer prompts, telemetry, or embeddings from the POC for model training or improvement unless explicit written opt-in is provided by the customer; retention and deletion will follow the POC onboarding configuration and the DSAR runbook supplied."

sam_infra: I'll prepare region-specific artifact examples (S3 delete markers + ledger entry sample) and attach them to the walkthrough. Also: confirm we will pin the POC to eu-west-1 and enforce VPC endpoints.

eli_security: Scheduling: MedTechEU wants a 45-min technical walk on Tue 11:30 CET or Wed 09:00 CET. Who can join from legal/privacy/infra?

maria_sales: I'll take Tue 11:30 CET with medtech lead. Sam, Nora, Eli please confirm.

sam_infra: I can do Tue 11:30 CET.

nora_privacy: Tue 11:30 CET works for me. I'll bring the DSAR runbook and the DPA clause.

eli_security: I'll join Tue 11:30 CET and share the CAIQ excerpts + the CSV mapping. I'll also include a short dataflow diagram in the invite.

maria_sales: Great. I'll send calendar invite and attach the CSV mapping + DPA clause. Will mark it as "technical vendor review" so their procurement team sees it.

legal-bot: ACTION: attach poc_trial_dpa_v2 and subprocessors_declaration_v1 when sending.

maria_sales: Done. Sent invite and included the mapping in the body. Tagging you all for follow-up when they respond. :white_check_mark:

(edited)
